provider.execution_boundary: External search calls were executed interactively and their result metadata was frozen here. The later Python adapter replays this frozen provider response; it does not pretend to repeat the network search.
provider.raw_payload_retention: Normalized result metadata and dispositions are retained; proprietary ranking payloads and complete result-page HTML were not exposed by the provider.

coverage_limits: This is a broad multi-query surveillance pass, not a systematic review or an exhaustive search.
The provider may omit unindexed, paywalled, non-English, newly posted, or poorly ranked records.
No complete citation-graph closure, author search, journal-by-journal search, or proof audit was performed.
Search-result discovery and primary-page inspection establish metadata and author-stated claims only.
SSRN pages that returned HTTP 403 and restricted Zenodo files were dispositioned from visible provider metadata, not treated as inspected proofs.
Absence from the capture is not evidence of novelty, nonexistence, or correctness of a competing claim.
inclusion_policy: Retain authoritative target status, current reviews, rigorous bounded results, conceptual genealogy, and direct solution claims that materially change reading or audit priorities. Direct solution claims remain unverified unless independently proved.
exclusion_policy: Exclude target mismatches, duplicate or secondary-host copies, inaccessible records lacking enough metadata for a claim audit, informal social posts, and claims with an explicit withdrawal from evidentiary support; retain important exclusions as surveillance records.
